summary: Ultimate Tax & Advisory is a Mount Lawley (Perth) boutique tax and advisory firm founded on 1 July 2016 by Bobby and Krystal Serval. Krystal, Practice Director, manages the bookkeeping, tax, accounting and admin departments and is skilled in Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks. The firm runs bookkeeping (coding, payroll, IAS/BAS) and Xero setup, and Krystal posted in February 2026 that it is looking to expand the team.
